_note: Approved/limited_use snapshot only. Not the full research dataset. A phrase here is a candidate to consider when it fits the exact meaning, platform, audience and register of the copy you're writing — never insert it just because it's listed.

phrases.usage_guidance: Already live in ms/index.html (title/meta/hero) — confirmed as real, externally corroborated market vocabulary via multiple independent .my sources, not just an internal assumption.
phrases.good_example: Sepenuhnya percuma, senang gila nak guna — tinggal salin tampal je!
phrases.avoid_when: Do not conflate with Indonesian 'salin tempel/copas' — MY and ID use different verbs for the same action.

phrases.usage_guidance: Use in CTA/meta copy for a future ms/ build — confirmed distinct from Indonesian usage.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not substitute Indonesian 'gratis' in MY-targeted copy.

phrases.usage_guidance: Good marker of genuinely native MY register if used in example/FAQ copy aimed at a young MY audience; do not use in formal copy.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use in formal/editorial register.

phrases.usage_guidance: Same source/context as MS-003 — use together as evidence of genuine MY colloquial register, not individually.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use in formal/editorial register.

phrases.usage_guidance: Stronger MY-distinctiveness marker than MS-005 since no Indonesian equivalent word was found — good candidate for a future MY-vs-ID calibration note.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use in formal/editorial register.

phrases.usage_guidance: Good candidate for a MY-targeted how-to title/H1 phrasing ('Cara Nak Buat...') if a ms/ build happens.
phrases.good_example: Cara Nak Buat Simbol Nama Aesthetic
phrases.avoid_when: Do not substitute Indonesian 'mau' in MY-targeted copy.

phrases.english_concept: decorative Unicode symbols for a name/bio
phrases.usage_guidance: Strongest single MY search formulation found — but CROSS-LOCALE LEAKAGE RISK: 'aesthetic' is a bare English loanword likely shared with Indonesian usage too; check the id/ lexicon before treating as MY-exclusive.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not treat as MY-exclusive without an explicit id-side comparison check first.

phrases.english_concept: romantic couple's-name convention for contact names
phrases.usage_guidance: Good candidate for a 'romantic contact names' ready-made example list if a ms/ WhatsApp-naming feature/section is ever built.

phrases.english_concept: fancy / decorative styled text (the Malaysian head term)
phrases.usage_guidance: Safe as an MY head term or an H1-supporting synonym. ms/index.html currently leads with 'Tulisan Aesthetic & Font Hebat' and mentions 'tulisan cantik' only once, deep in body prose — this record is evidence that 'cantik' has real independent MY competitor traction (a whole .my domain is named after it) and may deserve more weight in MY copy. It supports, never replaces, whichever single primary query target the page already owns.
phrases.good_example: Tukar teks biasa anda kepada tulisan cantik dalam beberapa saat — salin tampal terus ke bio IG.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use on id/ pages — Indonesians say 'tulisan keren'/'tulisan aesthetic', not 'tulisan cantik'. Also avoid in gaming-nickname copy aimed at male players, where 'cantik' reads feminine and 'hebat'/'power' is the register (see P5).

phrases.usage_guidance: Use as the MY noun for the tool in titles and tool copy: 'penjana fon', 'penjana huruf', 'penjana tulisan cantik'. The public repo's ms/ pages already use 'penjana' 36 times, so this is confirming existing production practice against external MY sources rather than proposing a change.
phrases.good_example: Penjana fon percuma — taip sekali, dapat berpuluh gaya tulisan.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not port 'penjana' into id/ copy — Indonesian pages should say 'generator font'. Also avoid stacking it with the English 'generator' in the same title ('penjana font generator') — that reads as machine translation.

phrases.usage_guidance: Use in the explanatory half of MY copy — 'which aksara khas does this platform accept', 'why an aksara khas got rejected'. Pairs with, does not replace, MS-008 'simbol aesthetic' which belongs in the browse/choose half. Keeping the two registers separate is the point of this record.
phrases.good_example: Sesetengah platform tidak menerima aksara khas dalam nama pengguna — gunakan gaya yang lebih selamat.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use in playful/decorative headings where the user is browsing symbols for fun — 'simbol aesthetic' or 'simbol' is the natural register there. Do not use on id/ pages; Indonesian uses 'karakter khusus'/'simbol'.

phrases.content_surface: body, faq, tool copy; usable in H2 on a gaming usecase page
phrases.usage_guidance: Use as the explanatory noun in MY body/FAQ copy. Do NOT let it displace the bare English 'nickname' in the *query-target* slot without evidence — Malaysian gamers also code-switch to 'nickname' constantly (see P7, bahasa rojak), and the live ms/usecase pages target 'nama ML'/'nama FF' rather than 'nama panggilan ML'. This is a body-copy naturalness aid, not a retargeting instruction.
phrases.good_example: Salin nama panggilan baharu anda, kemudian tampal dalam ruangan nama di dalam game.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use where the user's own query is the short form ('nama ML', 'nama FF') — a longer formal phrase in the H1 would be less natural than what they typed. Do not use on id/ pages.

phrases.usage_guidance: A spelling-register decision, not a translation. Prefer 'fon' when the surrounding copy is formal/product-voiced ('Penjana fon percuma'); the bare English 'font' is entirely natural in casual MY copy and in queries. The live ms/index.html already mixes both deliberately ('Fon Salin Tampal Online' in the title, 'font power' in the meta) — that mix is defensible, but it should be a decision per slot, not accidental.
phrases.good_example: Fon salin tampal online — percuma, tanpa daftar.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not spell it 'fon' on id/ pages — Indonesian never does this and it will read as a typo. Do not switch spellings mid-sentence or mid-heading.

phrases.english_concept: an eye-catching font — the neutral MY descriptor a creator reaches for when neither 'cantik' (feminine-leaning) nor 'hebat' (masculine/gaming-leaning) fits
phrases.avoid_when: Low measured search volume — treat as body-copy naturalness, not a query target. Do not promote to a title/H1 slot on this evidence alone.

phrases.usage_guidance: Use 'kad ucapan hari guru' for MY-market Teacher's Day content; if an ID equivalent is ever built, confirm the November date and Indonesian phrasing separately rather than reusing this entry -- the observances share a name pattern but not a date.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not reuse for Indonesia's Hari Guru Nasional (different date, likely different common phrasing) without separate verification.

phrases.usage_guidance: CANDIDATE. Format qualifier, not a head term. Relevant only if a printable card artifact is ever built - it names the expected physical format in MY.
phrases.good_example: kad ucapan hari guru boleh lipat
phrases.avoid_when: Meaningless on a copy-paste Unicode page - there is nothing to fold. Only applies to a printable artifact.
